title: Scene toggle does not update status after turning off all lights
description: When attempting to turn off all lights by toggling the main lights switch, the individual scene toggles do not reflect the off state, creating a discrepancy between the overall status and individual scene statuses.
steps: Observe the list of scenes, each with a toggle switch.
Tap the toggle switch for the 'Medium Intensity' scene to turn it on.
Tap the toggle switch for the 'low intensity' scene to turn it on.
Observe the main 'Lights' toggle at the top of the screen.
Tap the main 'Lights' toggle to turn off all lights.

Observe that the individual scene toggles for 'Medium Intensity' and 'low intensity' remain in the 'on' state, while the main 'Lights' toggle appears to be off or in an indeterminate state (visual confirmation of main switch state is unclear due to overlay).
Navigate to the 'Zone Control' screen by tapping on a scene (e.g., 'low intensity').
Observe the toggle switches within the zone control section; they appear to be off.
Navigate back to the main scenes list.
Observe that the individual scene toggles for 'Medium Intensity' and 'low intensity' are still visually 'on', despite the overall action to turn off all lights.
Tap the toggle switch for the 'low intensity' scene to turn it off.
Tap the toggle switch for the 'Medium Intensity' scene to turn it off.
actual: After toggling the main 'Lights' switch to turn off all scenes, the individual scene toggle switches (e.g., 'Medium Intensity', 'low intensity') remain in the 'on' state. When navigating to a scene's detailed 'Zone Control' screen, the toggles within that screen correctly reflect an 'off' state, but the main scenes list does not update.
expected: When the main 'Lights' toggle is used to turn off all lights, all individual scene toggle switches should update to reflect the 'off' state. The status displayed on the main scenes list should accurately represent the current state of all lights.
